item.title: Benchmarking Nox against ComfyUI
item.description: A speedup is only meaningful if both sides did the same work. It is easy to make an inference engine look fast: run fewer steps, drop to a lower resolution, swap in a smaller or more aggressively quantized checkpoint, or compare a warm process against a cold one. We wanted the Nox benchmarks to be immune to all of that, so this post explains how the comparison is set up and then shows every output from the latest run next to its ComfyUI counterpart.
